items.question: What familial harm may result from an unremoved śalya affecting the site?
premises: An unremoved śalya produces harmful consequences.
One such consequence is the death of sons.
The death of sons leads to separation from relatives.
items.inference: Therefore an unremoved śalya may cause the death of sons and consequent separation from kin.
uncertainties: The antecedent of tena is inferred from the preceding verse as the śalya or its effect.
items.plain_english: Because of that, there may be the death of sons and separation from relatives.
